single_dose: adults 1000 mg + 125 mg || children 600 mg + 42.9 mg
mechanism_of_action: blocks the synthesis of the cell wall of microorganisms and has a bactericidal effect
side_effects: bleeding time prolongation, allergic skin reactions, gastrointestinal issues
